# Spec Review

## Inputs

Approved feature/design/task, diff, tests and implementation evidence.

## Process

Read `AGENTS.md`, confirm the active lifecycle state and authority, inspect only relevant canonical artifacts, and make no assumption that is not supported by evidence or an explicit decision.

## Required output

Requirement checklist, omissions/scope creep, evidence, PASS or FAIL verdict.

Include artifact paths, traceability links, risks, evidence, owner, and recommended next lifecycle state.

## Stop conditions

Stop and FAIL on any unmet requirement, extra behavior, missing evidence, or changed acceptance criterion.
